title: About Dar Global PLC - International Luxury Real Estate Developer
content:
Dar Global PLC is an international luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). It was established to pioneer luxury second-home development across prime global destinations, combining high-end design, exclusive branded hospitality, and world-renowned fashion icons.

Core mission: Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment

Key Pillars:
- Global Footprint: London (UK), Dubai (UAE), Muscat (Oman), Doha (Qatar), Costa del Sol / Marbella (Spain), Bosnia, and Maldives.
- Co-branding with global luxury icons: ELIE SAAB, Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Missoni, Trump Organization, W Hotels, Aston Martin, and Mouawad.
- Target Audience: High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWIs) seeking capital appreciation, prime rental yields, and residency/golden visa opportunities.
- Governance: Adheres to the high corporate governance and transparency standards of the London Stock Exchange.

title: AIDA Muscat - Cliffside Golf & Luxury Community (Oman)
content:
AIDA is a master-planned 3.5 million square meter mixed-use cliffside oceanfront community developed by Dar Global in Muscat, Oman, perched 130 meters above the Gulf of Oman.
- Partnerships: Features the Trump International Golf Club Oman, an 18-hole championship golf course, alongside a luxury Trump Hotel and villas.
- Offerings: 3 to 7 bedroom luxury villas, ocean-view townhouses, and golf-front residences.
- Ownership: Freehold for all nationalities (Integrated Tourism Complex status), granting permanent residency eligibility in Oman.
- Location: Just 20 minutes from downtown Muscat and Muscat International Airport.

title: DaVinci Tower by Pagani (Dubai Canal)
content:
DaVinci Tower is an ultra-exclusive residential landmark on the Dubai Water Canal in Downtown Dubai, featuring interiors crafted by Italian hypercar legend Pagani Automobili.
- Design: Inspired by Horacio Pagani's philosophy of combining art and science, with exposed carbon fiber accents, bespoke Italian furnishings, and kinetic architectural elements.
- Residences: 2 to 4 bedroom apartments and signature penthouses with sweeping views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Water Canal.
- Developer: Dar Global PLC.

title: Urban Oasis by Missoni (Dubai Canal)
content:
Urban Oasis is a vibrant luxury residential tower located directly on the Dubai Water Canal, boasting interiors curated by the renowned Italian fashion house Missoni.
- Design aesthetic: Signature Missoni zig-zag patterns, artistic geometries, and vibrant color palettes throughout common areas and living spaces.
- Offerings: Studios, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom canal-facing residences.
- Amenities: Infinity swimming pool overlooking the canal, state-of-the-art gymnasium, private aquatic lounges, and 24/7 concierge.

title: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini (Benahavís, Marbella, Spain)
content:
Tierra Viva is an ultra-luxury residential enclave situated in Benahavís, near Marbella on Spain's Costa del Sol, developed in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini.
- Residences: 53 private villas perched across multiple elevation tiers overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.
- Villa Types: Diamante (6 bedrooms), Zafiro (5 bedrooms), and Esmeralda (4 bedrooms).
- Features: Direct elevator access to all levels, rooftop terraces, private infinity pools, manicured gardens, and design inspired by Lamborghini sports cars.

title: Les Vagues by ELIE SAAB (Qetaifan Island North, Qatar)
content:
Les Vagues by ELIE SAAB is the premier branded residential development on Qetaifan Island North in Lusail, Qatar.
- Design: Elegantly envisioned by haute couture designer Elie Saab, featuring flowing architectural lines reminiscent of ocean waves.
- Offerings: 1, 2, and 3-bedroom sea-front luxury apartments with floor-to-ceiling glass windows and panoramic Gulf views.
- Amenities: Private beach access, landscaped swimming pools, high-end fitness center, and branded fashion boutiques.

title: Dar Global Unit Reservation & Token Payment Policy
content:
Dar Global implements a structured, transparent unit reservation mechanism:
1. Token Amount: Customers may secure an exclusive reservation on a selected unit by paying a non-refundable token amount.
2. Reservation Window: The reservation period lasts strictly seven (7) calendar days from the date the token amount is received.
3. Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA): Before the 7-day reservation period expires, the customer must:
   a) Pay the initial required deposit installment of the purchase price in full.
   b) Sign and execute the Developer's official Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA).
4. Forfeiture Condition: If the buyer fails to complete the deposit payment or sign the SPA within the 7-day window, the reservation automatically terminates and the token amount is forfeited without further notice.
5. Payment Gateways: Supports international wire transfers and secure card payments via Tap Payment Gateway.

title: About Wasalt - Saudi Arabia Premier Real Estate Marketplace
content:
Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is Saudi Arabia's leading real estate platform and digital marketplace.

Overview: Wasalt is a Saudi-based real estate platform that makes it easier to discover properties, explore opportunities, and connect with property experts across the Kingdom. Whether you’re looking to buy, rent, sell, or invest, Wasalt brings the right properties, insights, and services together in one place.

Key Platform Capabilities:
- Verified Properties: 100% compliant with Saudi Real Estate General Authority (REGA / Fal license) standards to prevent fraudulent listings.
- Residential & Commercial: Comprehensive listings for rent, buy, and lease across all 13 Saudi provinces.
- 360-degree Virtual Tours: High-resolution virtual walkthroughs and floor plans.
- Interactive Map Search: Precise GIS-backed map exploration of neighborhoods, nearby mosques, schools, healthcare centers, and metro stations.
- Real Estate Auctions (Mazadat): Direct access to judicial, governmental, and private real estate auctions across the Kingdom.
- Off-Plan Developments: Showcase of major Wafi-licensed residential and commercial master communities.

title: Saudi Real Estate Regulations: REGA, Fal Licensing, and Ejar System
content:
Wasalt operates in strict accordance with the Saudi Ministry of Housing and Real Estate General Authority (REGA):
1. Fal License Verification: Under Saudi law, all property advertisements must have a valid Fal license number issued by REGA. Wasalt verifies licenses to protect buyers and tenants from fictitious ads.
2. Ejar System Integration: In Saudi Arabia, all residential and commercial tenancy contracts must be registered electronically on the government 'Ejar' network to be legally binding and executable in court.
3. Wafi Program Compliance: Off-plan sales must be licensed under the Wafi program to guarantee escrow account protections for purchasers.
4. Transparent Commission: Brokerage commission is legally capped at 2.5% of the transaction value unless mutually agreed otherwise in writing.

title: Wasalt Mortgage Calculator & Saudi Real Estate Financing Partners
content:

- Sakani Housing Program: Information for eligible Saudi citizens to benefit from subsidized real estate loans and government housing initiatives.
- Down Payment: Standard minimum down payment in Saudi Arabia is 5% for first-time Saudi home buyers on properties up to SAR 1,000,000, and 10-30% for general residential and commercial acquisitions.

A: Wasalt is a leading platform in Saudi Arabia for electronic real estate services, licensed by the Real Estate General Authority (REGA).

A: Click the profile icon (top left on the web or via the burger menu in the app). Enter your mobile number and complete OTP verification.

A: Wasalt Auctions is a feature where real estate assets are sold through timed auctions. Bidders can compete to determine the final sale price. Auctions include assets from private sellers and those in collaboration with Infath (Entrustment and Liquidation Center).

A: Matchmaker helps you find potential leads based on your live listings. It matches leads based on the property type, purpose, district, and category of your live property. Once your listing is live, Matchmaker will show leads that match those preferences, making it easier for you to connect with the right leads.
